body: Let's say you set the default value of a `RefinementList` on the `"animals"` facet to `["cats"]`. When you first load the page, this default value won't be shown in the URL. The only way to deselect the `"cats"` value in this case is to explicitly set the `"animals"` facet value to an empty array. Just removing the entire facet value won't do, because then the default value will be selected again.
